tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List every BotPlaza skill with its tagline, category, audience, default schedule, and cost level.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search BotPlaza skills by keyword across names, taglines, descriptions, and tags.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill's install kit: the ready-to-run install prompt for the chosen assistant (with SKILL.md inside), setup steps, and its data-access and safety notes. Prefer install_skill, which also returns the raw SKILL.md and setup questions.

tools.name: install_skill
tools.description: Everything needed to install one skill in a single reply: the full SKILL.md text, the ready-to-paste prompt for your platform, steps, suggested schedule, setup questions, safety notes, and URLs. Save skillMd as a skill, ask the setup questions once, and create the routine only if the user agrees.

tools.name: list_bundles
tools.description: List skill bundles: curated sets of skills (e.g. a morning routine) that install together with one prompt.

tools.name: install_bundle
tools.description: Get one bundle's combined install kit: a single prompt that saves every member skill, creates each routine on its schedule, and asks the setup questions once, plus members, merged safety notes, and URLs.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List bot teams: groups of bots with distinct roles that work together in a shared group chat.

tools.name: install_team
tools.description: Get one team's install kit: a prompt that creates one bot per role with its skill plus a shared group chat (Grok Bot), or a single assistant playing each role (other platforms), with mandatory safety rules.
